about: Memory v2 (tessaya-ops research/MEMORY-V2-DESIGN.md). People: a question names a person or project by a name or alias that the item about them never repeats, so only a people-and-projects layer (MEMV2-7) links them. Persona: an item marked persona-only (`persona`, `visibility: persona`) reaches the persona that learned it and no other (MEMV2-5); until then it is household and every persona sees it. Synthetic and generic: no real person's data.
